snippet.title: The Adventures Of Gael Longsword - An open world fantasy steampunk RPG (coming to STEAM soon)
snippet.description:
The Adventures of Gael Longsword is a single player, ambitious fantasy, steampunk RPG franchise set across the mysterious islands of Mercia and Grognorok. Blending open-world exploration, rich storytelling, memorable characters, humour, horror, puzzles, traps, dungeons,platforming, and cinematic adventure, the series is designed as a long-term, multi-volume fantasy saga. The first volume demo will be released soon on a steam page, the main game to be released sometime in spring after Steam Next Fest.

 Inspired by years of playing dungeons and dragons with the dwarf character Gael Longsword, the game aims to deliver a unique fantasy experience with its own identity, humour, lore, and an expanding universe. Players embark on an epic journey through a richly crafted world inhabited by Humans, Elves, Dwarves, Orcs, monsters, and an emerging steampunk civilization, uncovering ancient mysteries, forging alliances, battling dangerous enemies, and exploring the continent. 

The game is an :

 • Original fantasy IP with extensive lore, world map, characters, and a long-term franchise roadmap.
 • Multi-volume narrative structure designed for ongoing expansion, player retention, and franchise growth.
 • Open-world exploration combined with narrative-driven storytelling, meaningful character interactions, and cinematic presentation. 
• A distinctive blend of fantasy, steampunk, humour, horror, puzzles, platforming, and adventure.
 • Memorable cast of eccentric, expressive, and highly entertaining characters.
 • Strong visual identity utilizing Unreal Engine and MetaHuman technologies.
 • Original soundtrack and sound design created in-house by an experienced music producer and composer (myself, a life long dj and music producer).
 • An accessible but simple gameplay system designed to appeal to both dedicated RPG fans and broader gaming audiences. 

The Adventures Of Gael Longsword is inspired also by pc games such as : Skyrim, Oblivion, the Balders Gate series, Claire Obscure, Elden Ring, Crimson Dessert, God Of War, amoungst others. 

The game was made in Unreal Engine using the latest versions, incorporating inventory, combat systems, inspired by movies, 90s culture, comedians, the history of the United Kingdom, and authors such as Tolkien. 

The soundtrack is a combination of electronic, tribal, medieval, ethnic and world music styles, conjouring up the required atmosphere of different levels, adding to the horror, technological and mystical elements of the game.

I am open to help from investors and/or a publisher to build the game further and market it throughout the world and onto other platforms other than PC and steamdeck.

Contact : Josh (crazyrabbitrecordingz@gmail.com) https://bsky.app/profile/djdragonstears.bsky.social
